edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the transfer origin into _transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender when decrementing the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the from address of the internal transfer.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
setBots is restricted by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
delBot is restricted by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
manualswap authorization relies solely on msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization relies solely on msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
block.timestamp gates the cooldown mapping, making the buy restriction miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates to the internal _approve writer.
_transfer performs an external swap before finishing its own state updates.
_transfer pushes ETH to fee wallets after the external swap and before settling balances.
_transfer forwards to _tokenTransfer for the actual accounting.
_maxTxAmount is read in the require(amount <= _maxTxAmount) bound.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect buys and swap conditions.
_isExcludedFromFee is consulted before applying cooldown and fees.
swapEnabled controls whether the automatic swap block executes.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth invokes the untrusted router swap while only guarded by a single flag.
sendETHToFee performs raw ETH transfers to fee wallets inside the transfer flow.
manualswap calls the swap routine on the full contract balance.
manualsend distributes the contract ETH through sendETHToFee.
openTrading sends the contract balance through addLiquidityETH.
openTrading approves the router for the whole supply.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist mapping.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to derive reflection amounts.
_transferStandard debits and credits the _rOwned reflection balances.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal through SafeMath.sub on each transfer.
Fee totals accumulate into _tFeeTotal via repeated arithmetic.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable after the onlyOwner check.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the single trusted value authorizing manualswap.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the single trusted value authorizing manualsend.
uniswapV2Router is the external target of the swap call.
The router swap call returns control to the token contract while _transfer state writes are still pending.
ETH pushed to fee wallets can trigger a receive fallback that re-enters the transfer flow.
addLiquidityETH returns control to openTrading after pool creation.

normalization_plan.reason: from is only meaningful as the origin argument consumed by _transfer.
to is only meaningful as the destination argument consumed by _transfer.
amount is only meaningful inside the _transfer bounds and accounting.
sender is the caller-supplied account debited by transferFrom.
tAmount is the token amount decomposed by _transferStandard.
bots_ is only iterated to populate the blacklist.
notbot is only used to clear the blacklist entry.
account is only used to index _rOwned in balanceOf.
spender is only meaningful as the approval key.
tokenAmount is the swap input consumed by the router call.
owner is only used to write the allowance mapping.
contractTokenBalance is a cached balance used only to size the auto-swap.
contractETHBalance decides the amount passed to sendETHToFee.
currentRate is a transient reflection rate used only for amount scaling.
path is the routing array handed directly to the router swap call.
contractBalance is the amount forwarded to the swap performed by manualswap.
